d: Job Title: Admin Assistant (Bookkeeping & Inventory Management)

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and proactive Admin Assistant to support the financial and operational backbone of a creative, service-driven business. This role plays a critical part in maintaining accuracy across bookkeeping, payroll, inventory tracking, and vendor management while ensuring day-to-day operations remain organized, efficient, and reliable.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role ideal for someone who enjoys working with systems, numbers, documentation, and operational processes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, dependable, and capable of independently managing multiple responsibilities in a remote environment.

You will help create operational clarity by ensuring financial records, inventory systems, vendor relationships, and reporting processes are consistently maintained with precision and professionalism.
q: Proven experience in bookkeeping, accounting support, or financial administration
Hands-on experience with inventory management and vendor coordination
Strong proficiency with QuickBooks, Square, or similar accounting/payment systems
Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting, analysis, and tracking
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage workflows independently
Previous experience supporting small businesses, creative agencies, or service-based businesses
Familiarity with U.S. small business tax processes and compliance requirements
Experience with inventory management systems and operational reporting
Exposure to payroll processing and vendor contract management
Experience creating operational SOPs or process documentation
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
Relevant certifications or bookkeeping/accounting training are a plus
What Does a Typical Day Look Like?
An Admin Assistant in this role focuses on maintaining operational accuracy and supporting efficient business workflows. You will:
Manage and reconcile financial transactions and bookkeeping records
Process payroll-related tasks and maintain compliance documentation
Monitor inventory levels and coordinate restocking activities
Communicate with vendors and manage payment tracking
Update spreadsheets, reports, and operational documentation
Support process organization and improve administrative efficiency
In essence: you ensure financial accuracy, operational consistency, and organized systems that help the business run smoothly every day.
Accuracy and timeliness of bookkeeping and payroll processing
Compliance with reporting and documentation requirements
Organization and reliability of operational systems and records
Timely completion of administrative and financial workflows
Practical Assessment (Bookkeeping or Inventory Management Scenario)
r: Manage daily bookkeeping activities and maintain organized, accurate financial records
Process invoices, expenses, reconciliations, and transaction tracking
Support payroll calculations and ensure timely and accurate payment processing
Prepare and organize required financial and tax documentation
Assist in maintaining compliance with financial processes and reporting standards
Support implementation and optimization of accounting systems and workflows
Maintain organized digital records for financial reporting and audit readiness
Monitor inventory levels, stock movement, and usage trends
Coordinate inventory ordering and restocking processes
Maintain accurate inventory tracking systems and documentation
Identify shortages, overstocking, or inefficiencies and proactively recommend solutions
Generate inventory reports and cost tracking summaries as needed
Build and maintain professional vendor relationships
Track vendor invoices, contracts, payment schedules, and obligations
Execute expense management and vendor optimization initiatives
Coordinate vendor communications regarding orders, billing, or service issues
Support cost control and operational efficiency efforts
Maintain organized documentation across bookkeeping, inventory, and vendor systems
Create and update spreadsheets, trackers, and operational reports
Support internal process consistency and administrative workflows
Ensure data accuracy across reports, systems, and operational records
Assist leadership with administrative and operational support tasks as needed
What Makes You a Strong Fit
Highly detail-oriented with strong accuracy and organizational discipline
Reliable, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment
Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities calmly
Enjoys creating structure, maintaining systems, and improving operational processes
Communicates professionally and effectively with vendors and internal stakeholders
Process-driven with strong ownership and follow-through

d: Prep School Teachers for KS1 & 2 at Doha English Speaking School

Doha English Speaking School is Doha's leading not-for-profit school, renowned for its outstanding reputation in teaching and learning. In March 2023, DESS was rated Outstanding by PENTA International. The school is a proud member of prestigious organisations such as IAPS and BSME.

As a dynamic preparatory school with a clear vision, we place learning at the heart of our mission. Our students represent 45 nationalities (with 62% being British), creating a vibrant culture of success and enjoyment. Led by a dedicated and talented team of educators, we work collaboratively to uphold the highest academic standards while fostering a joyful and supportive working environment.
We have exciting opportunities for Class Teachers to join our prestigious organisation.

Having received Outstanding judgments in all 7 areas in the last BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection, you will join a fast-paced, dynamic school in Doha, Qatar, with highly supportive and collaborative structures that promote ongoing growth and development.
Fully furnished, air conditioned accommodation for sponsored staff
On site swimming pool and sports facilities
The chance to work in one of the sunniest and most rapidly developing cities in the world!
Candidates will be required to have their degree and transcripts attested by a notary public and stamped by the Qatari Embassy in the country where they were issued.

Interviews will be held in December 2027, and shortlisted candidates will be observed teaching (Interviews will be arranged in Doha for those already living locally or via video call for international candidates).
We invite you to visit our school website at https://www.dess.org/ to find out more about us. We look forward to receiving your application.
We reserve the right to close a position once we have received sufficient applications to form a shortlist. Early application is therefore encouraged.

Doha English Speaking School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. The successful candidate must be willing to undergo enhanced safeguarding checks and provide an ICPC (International Child Protection Certificate) or a local national equivalent, as well as a police clearance for any country of residence over the last ten years. We also require a copy of your birth certificate and, for any name changes, a marriage certificate or deed poll document.
The closing date is the 17th December 2026
You may be requested to complete video questions; please check emails regularly.
Alomar Holding Company is a leading Saudi-based diversified group specializing in real estate development, property and asset management, and strategic business ventures.

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Sales Representative to promote and sell furniture, décor, and custom woodwork solutions to corporate clients and project-based customers. The role focuses on managing the sales process, building strong client relationships, identifying new business opportunities, attracting new clients, and achieving sales targets.

The Sales Representative will work closely with clients and internal teams to understand project requirements, present suitable solutions, prepare quotations, negotiate deals, and convert sales opportunities into successful business transactions.
q: 2–5 years of professional experience in sales, preferably in furniture, décor, woodwork, interior design, fit-out, or related industries.
Proven experience in B2B sales, client acquisition, and closing sales deals.
Experience in prospecting and attracting new clients, developing sales opportunities, and expanding customer portfolios.
Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to understand client requirements and provide suitable product or project solutions.
Experience preparing quotations, proposals, negotiating commercial terms, and following up on sales opportunities.
Strong target-oriented mindset with the ability to achieve sales targets.
Good command of Arabic and English.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
Existing network of contacts within the furniture, interior design, construction, contracting, or real estate industries.
Experience handling project-based sales and corporate accounts.
Knowledge of furniture materials, décor products, custom woodwork, and interior furnishing solutions.
r: Promote and sell furniture, décor, and custom woodwork products and solutions to corporate and project-based clients.
Identify, approach, and attract new clients to expand the company's customer base and generate new sales opportunities.
Develop and maintain relationships with contractors, real estate developers, interior design firms, hotels, offices, and corporate clients.
Conduct client meetings, site visits, and presentations to showcase the company's products and services.
Understand customer needs, project requirements, specifications, and budgets to recommend suitable products and solutions.
Prepare quotations, proposals, and pricing offers, and follow up with clients to close sales deals.
Negotiate pricing, terms, and commercial agreements while maintaining profitability.
Manage sales leads, inquiries, and opportunities from initial contact through negotiation and closing.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure client requirements, orders, production, and delivery timelines are properly communicated and managed.
Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to encourage repeat business and long-term partnerships.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and potential projects to identify new sales opportunities.
Maintain accurate records of client interactions, sales activities, and pipeline using CRM systems.
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to revenue growth.
x: Pension scheme in accordance with Saudi labor regulations
Paid annual leave and public holidays
